contract_notes: G10 is an energy-only bypassable retail generation charge. Its embedded alternative-energy component must not be added again.
T08 is non-bypassable retail transmission. PJM/FERC cost references describe the rider's cost basis, not a separate wholesale settlement price for this retail bill.
T08 ordinary D19 demand applies to all billing kW, including the first 5kW. Calculator first5/remaining splits carry identical T08 rate values.
D19 NSPL billing is only for secondary accounts that opt in; no NSPL opt-in is assumed. PreJune2025 TCRR opt-out pilot accounts are excluded.
T08 low-load energy rate substitutes for both its demand and energy charges when D19 low-load provision applies; it is not an additional charge or an independent min cap.
T08 delegates billing-demand determination to D17-D25 and does not itself mandate invoice-cent selector rounding.
Service-rendered G10 and bills-rendered T08 must use distinct date semantics at June boundaries. A raw calculator meter-read boundary is not a legal effective date.
The complete total bill still requires distribution and riders, excise tax and any account-specific statutory treatment from the other ledgers. PTC alone is not the full retail bill.
